title.zh: 将国家政府在黎刹省Angono市镇取得的一块土地转为可处分或可转让的国有土地，分割后出售给该市镇无地居民并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert a Certain Parcel of Land Acquired by the National Government in the Municipality of Angono, Province of Rizal, into Disposable or Alienable Land of the Estate, to be Subdivided and Sold to the Landless Residents of Said Municipality, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act to Convert a Certain Parcel of Land Acquired by the National Government in the Municipality of Angono, Province of Rizal, into Disposable or Alienable Land of the Estate, to be Subdivided and Sold to the Landless Residents of Said Municipality, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3061_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The piece of land which was acquired by the National Government out of the funds appropriated under Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred for the municipal building site of the Municipality of Angono, Province of Rizal, covered by Transfer Certificate of Title Numbered sixty-five thousand six hundred ninety-three, is hereby converted into disposable or alienable land of the State, to be subdivided into small lots and sold at cost on installment basis to landless residents of said municipality: Provided, That no person can purchase more than one lot.

The proceeds from the sale of the lots to be sold under Section one of this Act shall be turned over to the Municipality of Angono for the renovation or completion of the municipal building of the said municipality.

The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, with the approval of the President of the Philippines, shall issue such rules and regulations as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
